title: GenAI evaluation logged-model metrics: pass the managed EvaluationDataset through to log_metrics so dataset name and digest are recorded
answers: Why do my mlflow.genai.evaluate aggregate metrics on the logged model show a null dataset name and digest when I pass model_id?
How do I get the dataset_name and dataset_digest attached to GenAI evaluation metrics for a managed evaluation dataset?
Where is the aggregate metric logging for mlflow.genai.evaluate handled, and how does the dataset reach it?
Does passing a plain list or DataFrame to mlflow.genai.evaluate change how its metrics are tied to a dataset?
body:
Path: mlflow/genai/evaluation/base.py:_run_harness builds the evaluation call for mlflow.genai.evaluate(data=..., model_id=...) and hands the evaluated dataframe, scorers and run_id to mlflow/genai/evaluation/harness.py:run, which computes aggregated scorer metrics and logs them to the run and logged model.
Rule: _run_harness forwards the managed dataset (mlflow_dataset, only when is_managed_dataset is true) as the dataset argument of harness.run, and run calls mlflow.log_metrics(aggregated_metrics, dataset=dataset). Any new aggregate-metric path in the GenAI evaluation flow should forward the same dataset object so logged-model metrics carry dataset_name and dataset_digest.
Symptom: After evaluating a managed EvaluationDataset with model_id, the logged model's metrics (e.g. <scorer>/mean) showed metric_dataset_name and metric_dataset_digest as null, while an explicit mlflow.log_metrics(..., dataset=dataset) call recorded both.
Constraints: Applies only when the caller explicitly supplies a managed evaluation dataset; plain list/DataFrame inputs pass dataset=None and keep the previous behavior (no dataset fields). Does not change per-row evaluation results, only the aggregate metric logging call.
applies: GenAI evaluation (mlflow.genai.evaluate) aggregate metric logging to a logged model when the data input is a managed EvaluationDataset.
says: Logged model metrics display null dataset name and digest after running GenAI evaluation.
Aggregate evaluation scores on the model are missing their associated dataset details.
Evaluation dataset name and digest should appear on logged model metrics.
Model evaluation summaries fail to link the managed dataset to aggregated metrics.
search: GenAI evaluation forwards managed EvaluationDataset instances to aggregate metric logging so logged-model metrics record dataset_name and dataset_digest. In mlflow/genai/evaluation/base.py:_run_harness and mlflow/genai/evaluation/harness.py:run, the managed dataset is passed to mlflow.log_metrics alongside aggregated scorer metrics. This resolves null metric_dataset_name and metric_dataset_digest values on models evaluated with model_id. Applies only when callers explicitly supply a managed dataset, whereas plain list or DataFrame inputs retain dataset=None without affecting per-row results.
